ios.desc:
Whisperer AI - Voice to Text Transcription

Turn any audio into accurate text, summaries, and actionable insights.

Whisperer is your intelligent AI transcription assistant, built for professionals, students, creators, journalists, and teams who want to capture audio and instantly turn it into structured, meaningful information.

Record or import any audio and transform it into clear, searchable text with powerful AI tools that save time, reduce effort, and boost productivity.

Capture Every Word with Precision

Whisperer delivers industry-leading transcription accuracy, automatic punctuation, and instant text generation, across dozens of languages.

- Ultra-accurate speech-to-text
- Automatic language detection
- Real-time transcription for live recordings
- Import and batch-process multiple audio files
- Instantly searchable and fully editable

AI That Understands Your Audio

Whisperer doesn’t just transcribe, it analyses your content and helps you extract what matters.

AI Summaries & Insights

- Automatic summaries, even for hours of audio
- Extract action items, decisions, tasks, and key points
- Create clear, structured meeting or lecture notes
- Generate clean PDF reports in one tap
- Automatically generate accurate titles for each recording

Chat with Your Audio

Ask questions, clarify ideas, or get more insights.
- Chat directly with any recording or transcript
- Request additional summaries
- Ask for explanations, rewrites, highlights, or topic breakdowns
- Perfect for study, revision, research, and business meetings

Powered by Smart Templates

Guide the AI before you record.

Whisperer includes a growing library of templates for professionals and students, such as:
- Meeting minutes
- Interview structure
- Research session
- Lecture notes
- Class summaries
- Brainstorming sessions
- Journalist interview formats and more

Create your own custom templates for consistent, high-quality results every time.

Designed for Professionals & Students

For Professionals

- Capture meeting minutes automatically
- Turn interviews into structured insights
- Perfect for consultants, journalists, product managers, lawyers, marketers, and remote teams
- Create polished PDF reports ready to send

For Students

- Record lectures with instant summaries
- Turn classroom audio into study-ready notes
- Chat with your lectures to ask questions or get simplified explanations
- Use templates to stay organized and save hours of rewriting

Why Choose Whisperer?

- Industry
